notes: A massive floating stone arena for a Tournament of Power style fight is Action, and the author's answers close both open questions: the smaller celestial platforms are backdrop only, so all combat stays on one level and this is the flat bounded arena rather than a multi-level one, and ring-out is the win condition. That makes Battlegrounds the preset almost exactly - hazard-kill is the open void edge a ring-out needs, cover-los is reworded onto the high-tech energy pillars the author asked to surround the arena, and spawn-protected keeps fighters from appearing in each other's line. I deliberately did not take island-cluster for the floating celestial platforms: the player never crosses them, so taking it would buy a CHECK for scenery. The nebulae, shifting dimensional colours and dramatic lighting are atmosphere over the same single-level floor, which keeps this on P0.
